title: Half the World's Coffee Comes From Two Countries
sentence: The USDA expects the world to grow 189.7 million bags of coffee in 2026/27: Brazil (71.9 million) and Vietnam (32.5 million) alone account for 55%, while the European Union and the United States import almost all the coffee they drink.
source: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, Coffee: World Markets and Trade (July 2026), 2026/27 forecasts: https://apps.fas.usda.gov/psdonline/circulars/2026/07/coffee.pdf
